newsitem.title: FRANCE: Montpellier says Jan-Sept air cargo up 8.3pct.
newsitem.headline: Montpellier says Jan-Sept air cargo up 8.3pct.

text.p: Air cargo traffic handled at Montpellier Airport in the first nine months of 1996 totalled 3,984 tonnes, up 8.3 percent on the same period last year, airport authority figures show.
Earlier this year, Montpellier was added to French express distribution operator, Jet Services' overnight air cargo network which operates BAe 146 QC (quick change) aircraft.
Montpellier features on an itinerary which reads: Paris/CDG-Strasbourg-Montpellier-Rennes-Marseille- Paris-CDG.
Airfreight is also carried by airlines operating passenger services to Montpellier, the majority ex-Paris, while the airport is also part of Air France's trucking network.
January-September 1996 postal traffic handled at Montpellier fell by 11.9 percent on the same period last year to 3,241 tonnes.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle hub and Montpellier using Boeing 737QC aircraft. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
